name: branch8-deepwiki
description: DeepWiki as a knowledge source: the Devin MCP (mcp.devin.ai, OAuth) for Branch8's own repositories indexed in Devin, and the public DeepWiki MCP (mcp.deepwiki.com, no auth) for open-source repositories. Claude consults it as project knowledge on its own initiative, shows the Devin sign-in status on the first turn, and walks the user through sign-in (or who to ask for an account) when a task needs it. Never starts paid Devin sessions on its own. Adds /deepwiki-login.
